title: Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs Bleed $592 Million as Clarity Act Fails in Senate
summary: Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) spot ETFs shed a combined $592 million on September 15. Both products posted their deepest single-day outflows in months.
